title: Run the OTA admin locally with an OTA of your own
caption: docs/mvp/local-development.md §2-§3. The demo OTA has no owner, so the console needs an OTA you create in the portal. Passwords are development only.

steps.title: One-time setup
steps.expect: Database `velexis` with the roles of `.env.example`; Redis password `dev_redis`; `.local/keys/` created.

steps.title: Seed the platform and the demo OTA
steps.expect: 40 test Amadeus offices `DEV1A0001`…; the demo OTA `tenant_demo` active (its keys printed once).

steps.title: Start everything
steps.body: `mailpit --smtp 127.0.0.1:1025 --listen 127.0.0.1:8025 &` and `pnpm dev` (portal 3000, platform API 3100, OTA API 4000, OTA admin 3002, storefront 5173).
steps.expect: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3002/health/ready` answers `200` once the OTA API is up.

steps.title: Sign up in the portal
steps.body: Create an account and open the verification e-mail in Mailpit (`http://localhost:8025`).
steps.expect: Signed in to the portal dashboard.

steps.title: Create an OTA
steps.body: Name and key; submit. The OTA worker provisions `tenant_<key>` and assigns a test office.
steps.expect: The OTA's page shows it **Active** with an active Amadeus test connection.

steps.title: Open the console
steps.expect: `http://localhost:3002/bookings` with your OTA's name, a TEST badge and "Owner" in the header.

steps.title: Get bookings to work on
steps.body: Set `STOREFRONT_DEV_HOST=<key>.ota.example.com` in `ota/frontend/.env.local`, restart the storefront and book on `http://localhost:5173`; or import a PNR of your office at `/pnr`.
steps.expect: The bookings appear in `/bookings` and `SELECT reference, status FROM tenant_<key>.bookings;`.
